description: Template for mapping raw directory paths, aggregated collections, and ambiguous filenames to verified generator, source, and identity metadata.
instructions: Fill in the mappings array for each distinct collection or source folder in your dataset.
Do not treat collection names (e.g. 'diffgan') as generator names; specify the actual generator (e.g. 'DDPM', 'LDM', 'StyleGAN2').
Specify source_roots if datasets reside on different drives or relocated folder paths.
Do not invent synthetic group IDs; provide verified source_video_id or identity_id if known.
